browse_api.description:
Chuck Berry – Chuck Berry's Greatest Hits

Chess Records LPS-1485 (Electronically Reprocessed Stereo)

Classic Chuck Berry compilation featuring many of the songs that defined early rock & roll.

Includes:

  • Johnny B. Goode
  • Roll Over Beethoven
  • School Days
  • Rock and Roll Music
  • Too Much Monkey Business
  • Nadine
  • Maybellene
  • Memphis
  • Sweet Little Sixteen
  • Thirty Days
  • Brown Eyed Handsome Man
  • Oh Baby Doll

A must-have for collectors of Chuck Berry, Chess Records, blues, and early rock & roll.
